description: This file contains class definitions and prototypes for representing GLES 3 Vertex Array Objects, including VertexArray and VertexArrayState classes, with methods for managing vertex attributes, bindings, and related state.

classes.name: VertexArray
classes.description: Represents a GLES 3 Vertex Array Object, managing vertex attributes, bindings, and state synchronization.

classes.name: VertexArrayState
classes.description: Encapsulates the state of a vertex array, including attributes, bindings, and validation masks.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the vertex array state.

methods.name: getVertexAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific vertex attribute by index.

methods.name: setVertexAttribPointer
methods.description: Sets the vertex attribute pointer for a given attribute index.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the vertex array state with the underlying implementation.
